title: Two weeks of a 10:30 pm lights-out
hypothesis: If I turn the lights out by 10:30 pm for 14 nights, my average sleep goes up by 30 minutes and my morning HRV goes up by 4 ms.
why: Short nights are the clearest link to lower HRV in four years of my data.
protocol: Same wake time every day, weekends too

checkin.q: Minutes of screen time after 10 pm?

success: Average sleep of 7.0 h or more and average HRV of 55 ms or more across the 14 nights, with lights out on time at least 11 nights.
